title: RQ Hypothesis Chain
description: DESIGN-stage artifact. Output of rq-architect. Decomposes a research question into a chain of testable hypotheses, each with a falsifiable prediction and the evidence needed to test it. A chain missing a falsifiable_prediction or evidence_needed is schema-rejected.

research_question.description: The top-level research question being decomposed

hypotheses.description: Ordered chain of testable hypotheses; each must be independently falsifiable

statement.description: Declarative statement of what the hypothesis claims

falsifiable_prediction.description: Concrete, observable, falsifiable prediction — what specifically would be observed if the hypothesis is true vs false

evidence_needed.description: List of evidence types or experiments needed to test this hypothesis

depends_on.description: hypothesis_ids this hypothesis logically depends on

rq_notes.description: Optional clarifications about the research question scope or assumptions
